run_valid_actions: run valid_actions.py to print all valid StarCraft II base actions and their flattened action counts
run_valid_actions_hide_specific: run valid_actions.py with --hide_specific flag to print only general actions excluding specific ones
run_valid_actions_screen_size: run valid_actions.py with --screen_size flag to set custom resolution for screen actions
run_valid_actions_minimap_size: run valid_actions.py with --minimap_size flag to set custom resolution for minimap actions
summarize_valid_actions: summarize valid_actions.py which prints valid StarCraft II actions from the action spec with argument size calculations
